items.title: Hiscox cuts quote times using AI as London Market underwriting retreats
items.summary: Hiscox has accelerated its artificial intelligence rollout, reducing broker submission turnaround times by 75% in lines such as terrorism and engineering.

items.title: Crawford reports net income rise alongside drop in free cash flow
items.summary: Crawford & Company reported a 24 percent rise in nine-month net income alongside a 69 percent drop in free cash flow.

items.title: MainStreet Partners absorbed by Allfunds following restructuring
items.summary: ESG advisory and portfolio analytics firm MainStreet Partners has been folded into Allfunds following a strategic review.

items.title: APAC reinsurance buyers benefit from market softening, says OneGlobal
items.summary: Asia Pacific reinsurance buyers are broadly benefiting from market softening with greater choice, though outcomes remain risk-dependent.

items.title: Lloyd’s Asia targets growth while maintaining underwriting discipline
items.summary: Emma Loynes outlined growth opportunities for Lloyd's Asia at the SIRC conference while committing to ongoing market discipline.

items.title: International banks review loan terms and exposures as super El Niño builds
items.summary: International lenders including BBVA, Standard Chartered and CaixaBank are reviewing loan portfolios and assessing credit risks as a super El Niño cycle develops across the Pacific.
